title: A finite-order answer to a problem of Erdős on maximum modulus points
summary: In 1964, Erdős asked whether, for a non-monomial entire function, the number of maximum modulus points on the circle \(|z|=r\) can become arbitrarily large as $r\to\infty$. In 1968, Herzog and Piranian answered this question affirmatively, but without quantitative control on the resulting function. We prove that such an example can be chosen to have finite order and, moreover, to belong to the Eremenko--Lyubich class \(\B\).
